basics.name: Samuel Lanctot
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Full-stack engineer with nine years across insurance and banking, currently building commercial insurance software at GEICO. I automate the work nobody should be doing by hand — issue pipelines, deployment flows, underwriting operations — and the systems I build have removed hundreds of thousands of dollars in annual manual-processing cost while the business grew past $1B in premium.

work.name: GEICO
work.summary: Commercial insurance platform — DuckCreek policy administration and Next.js service applications.
highlights: Automated issue-intake and triage processes across the commercial division, eliminating manual routing work and saving hundreds of thousands of dollars in annual operating cost.
Built and maintained Next.js service applications integrating with DuckCreek policy administration during a period in which GEICO Commercial grew past $1B in written premium.
Led reliability work on policy-issuance pipelines, cutting failed-issuance escalations and keeping underwriters out of ticket queues.
Mentored engineers joining the commercial platform teams as headcount scaled with the business.

work.name: Capital One
work.summary: Full-stack development on cloud-native money-movement services.
highlights: Built and operated microservices in Node.js, Python, and Scala on AWS, serving customer money-movement flows.
Owned service reliability for a distributed transaction pipeline, including on-call, observability, and incident response.
Drove AWS well-architected reviews and cost tuning across the team's services.
